title: Sunswept Breeze - 12-16 Guests+POOL | Restaurants
description: You’ll love being minutes away from ASU, the Salt River, hiking and golfing, plus the Cubs Spring Training facility and so much more! Sunswept Breeze is not only in the perfect location, but also offers a sparkling pool, furnished covered patio, BBQ,  game room with board games and Foosball table. This 2,300 sq. ft. 6 bed 3 bath home sleeps 12 to 16 guests.
review_snippets: Perfect family house for an ASU graduation. We enjoyed being able to have all the family under one roof and to be able to swim. Location is great for ASU.

House was perfect for the amount of people we had. Location was what we been looking for all these years. It's been a family vacation every year in march for the past 17 years.  Hope we are able to rent this place for our next march 2027 family vacation again.
The property is great. The house is very spacious and gave us plenty of room. The only comment I would make is some of the beds have reached their lifetime limit and need to be replaced.
This house was perfect for our basketball team’s stay! Quick drive to everywhere we needed and wanted to go. Very communicative host as well.

We really enjoyed this location and are grateful to the hosts for providing plenty of towels to accommodate our large family. Plenty of entertainment was provided through TVs , pool, a game table, and also board games and travel brochures showing us the many things that we could do in the area. I would recommend this spot to anyone traveling in a larger group :)
